evidence: ALD NiO films were deposited in ALD reactor F120 (ASM Microchemistry) at Tg = 300 /C176C from Ni(C5H5)2 precursor and O3 as oxygen source; the Ni precursor was maintained at Tp =4 0/C176C during deposition. We recall that an ALD process consists of an alternating insertion of the precursor and the oxidizing gas in the main chamber, maintaining a self-limited reaction regime by controlling the pulse and cycle duration, in such a way that the organic precursor molecule is broken, the metallic ion is fully oxidized and the volatile components are expelled by the deposition chamber during the purging step in N2.
